## Code Review Summary
Mode: specification · pass: repair (r5, verifying F1–F8). Files reviewed: spec plus verified source/test anchors. Total issues: 3.
Limits: read-only role, no shell; no build/test executed — all claims are source inspection.

### By Severity
CRITICAL 0 · HIGH 1 · MEDIUM 0 · LOW 2

### Issues

[CR5-1][ledger-state-drift][HIGH][confidence HIGH] Unenumerated cmd oracle depends on search fanout
File: cmd/mcp-bridge/serve_hybrid_progressive_reveal_test.go:342-432 (block :404-431)
ID: CR5-1 (new; same class as F8/CR3-2)
Issue: `TestServeHybridProgressiveRevealPages` (page size 2) captures `firstPage`, calls `search_tools`, then requires that pre-search cursor to fail with `invalid cursor` (:421-431). Cursors bind `projection.generation` (cursor.go:36-72; session_exposure.go:234-264) and generation increments on every rebuild (projection.go:233-238). Today search's commit (tools.go:515) rebuilds the projection and invalidates the cursor; R1/T2 remove that commit, so the generation is unchanged, the cursor stays valid, and the test fatals at :426-427. Neither §3, AC1/AC5, nor T3's cmd bullet enumerates this range — T3 edits only the `:360-363` expected map in the same test and is Prohibited beyond enumerated edits. The test also runs through the lifecycle table (serve_hybrid_progressive_reveal_lifecycle_test.go:24-27).
Consequence: T3/T4 validation `go test ./cmd/mcp-bridge/` cannot exit 0, with no authorized repair path.
Fix: add :342-432 to T3's edits and to AC1(cmd); require either (a) assert the pre-search cursor remains valid after search (the R1-consistent oracle), or (b) insert an explicit `expose_tools` before the stale-cursor assertion so invalidation is exposure-driven.

[CR5-2][ledger-state-drift][LOW][HIGH] AC8 is not claimed by T3 although T3 creates `TestDescribeDoesNotExpose` and the cmd absence half. Fix: add AC8 to T3's AC list.

[CR5-3][ledger-state-drift][LOW][MEDIUM] T1 "Files" omits `internal/catalog/catalog_test.go` while its RED step requires extending it. Fix: list the file.

### Open Questions
[F4 RED][LOW confidence] A pre-dispatch cancel likely aborts Search before any commit, so the rewritten cancellation oracle may already pass pre-T2 and thus not be the "real RED" §9(12) demands. Regression value remains; confirm at implementation.

### Closure evidence (F1–F8)
F1 closed: operationVocabulary (httpdiagnostics.go:660-666), 31 entries, excludes expose_tools; exactly two copies (log_test.go:428-433, DeepEqual :432); finiteEnum consumers need no edits. F2 closed: T2 :337-364 absence-only, T3 owns positive rewrite. F3 closed: :242-269 (fatal :269) inverted; :272-296 preserved; :301-305 inverted; :333-335 kept. F4 closed: hook at projection.go:1041 reachable only via commitDiscovery (:469). F5 closed: corrected anchors exact (projection.go:367/469/470; tools.go:581/604-613/625/682-691/694/714/1007; session_exposure.go:99-131/175-177; gate :41-45). F6 closed: :731 and :741 both 1054. F7 closed: README :288-289 plus :279/:315/:394/:398/:425-427/:453/:458-460 verified. F8 closed: reveal :227-236, fatal :236.

Counts verified: 4→5 built-ins, 54→55, 1054→1055, publish got 5→6, metadata map 4→5; cmd 4→5, 5→6, 6→7, 5→6, exposed_tools 4→5. No third vocabulary copy, no other `searchDiscoveryTargets` caller; metadata/coexistence/endpoint-rebind suites use pins or `call_tool`.

### Positive Observations
Anchor precision is high; the F5/F7 corrections are correct (the review-supplied `:433-435`/`:293-294` were stale). AD5 matches `directRequestOwner` (tools.go:364-378) and the publisher branch; AD9 mirrors describe_tool :604-625; AD6's pinned pre-filter is necessary because commitDiscovery merges interests; AD8 mirrors call_tool :801-802.
